newsitem.title: USA: R.I. Treasurer to meet with SEC's Levitt on reform.
newsitem.headline: R.I. Treasurer to meet with SEC's Levitt on reform.

text.p: Rhode Island General Treasurer Nancy Mayer is set to meet with Securities and Exchange Commission Chairman Arthur Levitt Thursday to discuss ways to reform the municipal securities industry.
Mayer will be representing the National Association of State Treasurers at the meeting, according to a statement released by her office.

The SEC is investigating whether Wall Street brokerage firms have charged artificially higher prices for securities that were sold to local governments in a complex bond deals. Levitt has said that "yield burning" in the municipal industry is among the problems his agency is probing.

Mayer will be accompanied by representatives from the International City/County Management Association, the National Association of Counties, the National Council of State Legislatures, the National Governors' Association, the National Leagues of Cities and the U.S. Conference of Mayors.
A spokesman for Mayer said the meeting was scheduled to take place Thursday afternoon at the SEC's Washington,D.C. headquarters.
